newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Sadia to build $37.5 mln unit.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Sadia to build $37.5 mln unit.

text.p: Brazilian food company and meat processor Sadia group will invest $37.5 million to build a new unit to make frozen goods and fresh pasta in the southern state of Parana, the firm said in a statement.
Company officials and Parana state governor Jaime Lerner will sign the deal Thursday, Sadia said.
The new factory will begin production in July 1998 and will create 312 direct jobs. Sadia also said it will invest $18 million in the first two years.
The unit will be located in Ponta Grossa, next to an existing industrial plant of Frigobras Cia. Brasileira de Frigorificos, one of the 12 companies belonging to the Sadia group, it added.
